statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit. A temporary Cloudflare 1015 response affected one repeat detail fetch, but the detail screenshot and later active playback probe succeeded, so no atomic check remained blocked.

page.framework: Server-rendered MPA with custom JavaScript and Video.js
page.notes: Public adult-media catalogue. Representative coverage includes listing, taxonomy, search, video playback, linked login and failure recovery. Excluded: upload/registration submission, destructive account actions, every category/video duplicate, and playback beyond confirming start.

principleOutcomes.reason: No agent-facing transaction or productivity capability is intended; ordinary crawlable content does not require WebMCP tools. No summarisation, generation or language-model task is part of the observed core experience.

paths.description: Homepage and primary catalogue listing; covers first impression, navigation, search entry, responsive cards, preferences and global metadata.
British Porn category listing; represents filtered listing templates and mobile reflow.
Search results reached through the homepage GET form; represents the primary find-content flow.
Representative video detail and playback start; covers the primary watch flow, media accessibility, advertising and rich metadata.
Cross-origin account login widget linked from the global header; covers authentication and input assistance.
Representative unknown route; covers HTTP/error recovery messaging.

findings.summary: The site remains light when the user requests a dark color scheme.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot remains on the same #f5f5f5 body surface as the default capture; the computed probe reports colorScheme "normal" and body background rgb(245,245,245).
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() for surfaces, text, form controls and browser chrome.

findings.summary: The page does not adapt animation when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the blink animation still runs with a 1000 ms duration and the probe finds no reduced-motion media rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce rule that removes the non-essential blink and suppresses non-essential transitions and autoplay motion.

findings.summary: The UI does not explicitly adapt to increased-contrast or forced-color preferences.
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast: more probe is active but finds no prefers-contrast or forced-colors media rule; the page capture is visually unchanged.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast styles that preserve boundaries, focus indicators, text and control visibility using system colors where appropriate.

findings.summary: MPA route changes use abrupt full-page swaps rather than cross-document View Transitions.
findings.evidence: DOM and CSS inspection across homepage, categories, search and detail templates found no @view-transition rule, view-transition-name or transition opt-in.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance same-origin navigation with @view-transition { navigation: auto } and stable view-transition-name values for persistent header and media elements.

findings.summary: Advertising and affiliate chrome competes strongly with the primary video content.
findings.evidence: The video first viewport shows two stacked sidebar ads beside the player, while global navigation presents campaign links such as Live Sex and Sex Today as ordinary destinations; the detail probe counts 34 ad-class/id elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce first-viewport ad density, reserve one clearly labelled placement, and visually separate commercial destinations from task navigation.

findings.summary: The category listing overflows a 360 px mobile viewport.
findings.evidence: The mobile layout primitive reports scrollWidth 447 px against clientWidth 360 px, producing 87 px of horizontal overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the fixed/minimum width that expands the layout, use intrinsic minmax/min() sizing, and verify every listing template at 320 to 360 px without overflow.

findings.summary: Reusable cards and navigation adapt only through viewport media queries.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection reports zero @container rules even though the same card/navigation patterns appear in different grid and sidebar contexts.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card/list containers an inline-size containment context and move local card adaptations to container queries.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is suppressed and many controls are below recommended touch size.
findings.evidence: The authored CSS contains :focus{outline:none}; focusing the first link yields outline-style none. Category links and pagination controls are roughly 30 px high, with many pagination targets near 30 by 31 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the blanket focus reset, add a high-contrast :focus-visible indicator, and enlarge compact controls to at least a 44 by 44 CSS pixel activation area.

findings.summary: One lab run puts LCP outside the Core Web Vitals good range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 2.8 s, above the 2.5 s good threshold, although the raw trace measured 1.10 s; CLS was 0.018 and TBT 0 ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the true LCP element, preserve the efficient main thread, and validate the improvement with repeated mobile Lighthouse runs and field data.

findings.summary: A parser-inserted preload script can delay initial parsing.
findings.evidence: HAR identifies preload-4eaff90568.min.js as a high-priority parser-inserted candidate; DOM confirmation shows a classic script without async, defer or type=module. Main JS is correctly deferred and the ad script is dynamically async.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer the preload helper or inline only the minimal critical portion, then verify that initialization order remains correct.

findings.summary: The homepage ships avoidable unused JavaScript and CSS.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse unused-code audits fail with two JavaScript items and one CSS item; HAR shows scripts account for 133 KB transferred and third parties account for 156 KB overall.
findings.suggestedFix: Use coverage results to split template-specific code, remove unused selectors, and load advertising or account code only when its surface is reached.

findings.summary: Many text and UI color combinations fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast fails with 66 affected nodes on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Rework muted text, metadata, chips and controls against their actual backgrounds to meet WCAG AA, then rerun automated and visual checks in all preference modes.

findings.summary: At least one homepage link has no discernible accessible name.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse link-name fails with one affected element; the DOM recon also includes multiple empty-text outbound anchors.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every linked image or advertising destination a meaningful accessible name and remove empty anchors that do not perform a user action.

findings.summary: The representative video exposes no captions or equivalent track.
findings.evidence: Before and after playback, all inspected video elements have zero track elements; the Video.js captions menu exists but contains only the off/settings entries.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide accurate WebVTT captions for each video and expose the track through the player; add transcripts where captions cannot convey all relevant information.

findings.summary: One above-the-fold image lacks explicit intrinsic dimensions.
findings.evidence: The images primitive finds one image without width and height attributes. The page otherwise has a valid HTML doctype, UTF-8 charset and correct sampled image aspect ratios.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic width and height to the logo/source candidate while retaining responsive CSS sizing.

findings.summary: Video detail pages have Open Graph tags but no VideoObject structured data.
findings.evidence: The detail probe finds a canonical URL and og:title/og:image, but zero JSON-LD blocks for the visible video entity.
findings.suggestedFix: Add schema.org VideoObject JSON-LD matching the visible title, thumbnail, duration, upload date and content URL, while retaining accurate Open Graph metadata.

findings.summary: HTTPS is used, but CSP and HSTS are absent and one cookie is insecure.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive reports no Content-Security-Policy or Strict-Transport-Security. The stop_redirect cookie is not Secure and uses SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy an enforcing nonce/hash-based CSP, enable HSTS after subdomain readiness, and set Secure with an appropriate SameSite value on every HTTPS cookie.

findings.summary: The response omits the browser policies that constrain framing, referrers, MIME sniffing and permissions.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive reports missing X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy in addition to absent CSP/HSTS.
findings.suggestedFix: Add nosniff, frame-ancestors (or X-Frame-Options as compatibility defense), strict-origin-when-cross-origin or tighter Referrer-Policy, and a minimal Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Third-party advertising and analytics receive a large default-load footprint.
findings.evidence: HAR records 9 third-party requests and 155,798 transferred bytes, about 44% of the 357,312-byte load. A Matomo request includes the full page URL, detailed user-agent data and screen resolution; tracker recon identifies five third-party origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential advertising/analytics behind explicit consent where required, minimise event fields, batch analytics, and defer third-party code until it provides direct user value.

findings.summary: The account widget offers password-only authentication with no passkey path.
findings.evidence: The linked login widget contains username and password fields; its rendered source has no PublicKeyCredential or navigator.credentials authentication flow. No permission prompt was observed on page load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey registration and authentication as the preferred path, with password recovery retained as a fallback.

findings.summary: Internationalisation foundations are inconsistent across linked surfaces.
findings.evidence: The main document declares lang="en", but the linked login widget has an empty html lang. CSS inspection of the main page found no logical inline/block properties despite a visible language selector.
findings.suggestedFix: Set the correct lang and dir on every document, propagate locale into the account widget, and migrate directional spacing/positioning to logical properties.

findings.summary: Commercial campaign links are disguised as ordinary primary navigation.
findings.evidence: Live Sex and Sex Today appear alongside Categories, Pornstars, Tags and Channels, but resolve to bannerator.com campaign URLs; the detail sidebar is labelled Advertisement, showing that the site can distinguish ads when it chooses.
findings.suggestedFix: Label sponsored/affiliate destinations clearly, visually separate them from first-party navigation, and disclose the external destination before activation.

findings.summary: Sign-in fields omit autocomplete tokens, and search explicitly disables autocomplete.
findings.evidence: The login probe reports blank autocomplete values for username and password; both homepage search inputs use autocomplete="off".
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete="username" and autocomplete="current-password" on sign-in fields; avoid disabling autocomplete on search unless there is a demonstrated privacy need.

findings.summary: Thumbnail delivery lacks responsive image candidates and modern formats.
findings.evidence: The images primitive reports 30 of 31 images without srcset, six legacy-format resources and zero modern-format images. Below-fold thumbnails are lazy-loaded and sampled images are not oversized.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP thumbnail variants and width-based srcset/sizes so each grid density downloads the smallest suitable image.

taskList.title: Restore keyboard/touch accessibility and color contrast
Deploy a complete security-header and cookie baseline
Minimise and gate third-party advertising and analytics
Fix the 360 px category overflow and component adaptation
Add dark, reduced-motion and increased-contrast preference support
Improve LCP and remove avoidable load-time code
Modernise login with passkeys and autofill
Fix language and bidirectional layout foundations
